subtitle: Design Project / Introduction

educationalGoal:
-To gain the basic skills needed in processes from finding problems to solutions.
-To understand phenomena, objectives, and events quantitatively and qualitatively.
-To be able to find characteristics and laws of phenomena, objectives, and events.
-To be able to deliver the above information to a third person intelligibly.
-To gain various basic skills to proceed smoothly with verification activities.
-To be able to have a picture of technology fields and engineers of discipline.
advice:
In this course, to achieve the above educational goals, the students will learn basic skills required for verification and problem-solving processes.
This course will deal with characteristic things of the corresponding department.
One is that the students will learn the basics of “data-handling skills” needed for data collection → organization → analysis→ hypothesis testing→ visualization → reporting.
One is that the students will learn the basic skills of “PBL for science and technology” including the basic elements of processes from problem-finding to solution and verification activities.
For “data-handling skills”, the students will learn the basics of conducting experiments and analyzing experimental data.
In particular, measuring the motor speed, calibration of sensors, flowcharts in programming, the concept of control, crank mechanism, and gear mechanism will be focused on.
For “PBL for science and technology”, the students will discuss the problem setting and build an original robot using LEGO Mindstorms to solve the problems. In particular, the validity of the developed robot will be investigated through verification experiments.

This course will deal with characteristic things of the corresponding department.
One is that the students will learn the basics of “data-handling skills” needed for data collection → organization → analysis→ hypothesis testing→ visualization → reporting.
One is that the students will learn the basic skills of “PBL for science and technology” including the basic elements of processes from problem-finding to solution and verification activities.
For “data-handling skills”, the students will learn the basics of conducting experiments and analyzing experimental data.
In particular, measuring the motor speed, calibration of sensors, flowcharts in programming, the concept of control, crank mechanism, and gear mechanism will be focused on.
For “PBL for science and technology”, the students will discuss the problem setting and build an original robot using LEGO Mindstorms to solve the problems. In particular, the validity of the developed robot will be investigated through verification experiments.
